title: Milwaukee MW101 PRO pH Meter, Professional Digital pH Tester with Temperature Compensation, Accuracy ±0.02 pH, Range 0-14 pH, Includes 2 AA Batteries
description: The Milwaukee MW101 PRO pH Meter is a professional-grade measuring instrument designed for precise pH measurements with an impressive accuracy of ±0.02 pH and a comprehensive range of 0.00-14.00 pH. This reliable device features temperature compensation functionality and convenient calibration options at pH 4/10 and pH 7. The meter comes with a clear digital display for easy reading and includes essential accessories like a pH probe and two AA alkaline batteries for immediate use. With its compact dimensions of 24 cm x 16 cm x 10 cm and lightweight build at 350 grams, this meter offers excellent portability for various applications. The device's robust construction and user-friendly interface make it ideal for laboratory settings, water quality monitoring, and other professional environments where accurate pH measurements are crucial. The included probe is designed for durability and consistent performance, while the temperature compensation feature ensures reliable readings across varying conditions.
